retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements code notes, 1P SCORE at 0x66d6-0x66d9 read byte-swapped, the millions first), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2, to find (no RetroAchievements note; two-player game, learn.bat score_p2=...)

lives.note: player 1 lives, like the 1UP on screen (RetroAchievements code notes, LIVES, address swapped; Seb's capture of 22:37)

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives, like the 2UP on screen (deduced, to be confirmed)

ammo.note: player 1 ammo, 2 bytes, 0xFFFF with the handgun (infinite)

weapon.note: player 1 weapon (RetroAchievements code notes): 0 handgun, 2 shotgun, 3 rocket launcher, 4 flame shot, 5 heavy machine gun, 6 laser, 12 enemy chaser, 13 iron lizard, 14 drop shot, 15 super grenade, 0x12 two machine guns; the same codes as Metal Slug 3 (Seb's capture of 22:37: 5, 3 and 18)

p1_chr.note: player 1 soldier: 0 Marco, 1 Trevor, 2 Nadia, 3 Fio (RetroAchievements code notes, CHARACTER ID, address swapped, right before his lives); to confirm in game

p2_chr.note: player 2 soldier, same codes, deduced: his block is 0xB0 further (lives)

prisoners.note: player 1 prisoners rescued in the mission (RetroAchievements code notes, 'prisoners captured parcial', address swapped, in his block); to confirm in game

prisoners_p2.note: player 2 prisoners rescued in the mission, deduced (0xB0 further)

vehicle.note: player 1 in a vehicle (1) or on foot (0) (RetroAchievements code notes, 'Inside Vehicle = 01', address swapped); which vehicle is not known, so the HD screen shows a plain vehicle; to confirm in game

vehicle_hp.note: energy of player 1's vehicle in % as shown on screen (RetroAchievements code notes, 'Vehicle health on screen', address swapped; full at 0x30 as in the other games, to confirm), shown while he is in it

vehicle_hp_p2.note: energy of player 2's vehicle, deduced (0xB0 further)

_hps.note: the life of every enemy of the game's table, 73 entries of 176 bytes from 0x101080, the life at 0xAA in each (the twelve lives of the RetroAchievements notes, bosses, tanks and vehicles, all sit there: 0x102EBA, 0x103E8A, 0x10414A, 0x10112A, 0x10175A, 0x1042AA...). Seb's captures of 23:58 and 00:22: Brave Guerrier, the boss of mission 1, came once in the 90th entry and once in the 67th, with 250 of life, so the HD screen watches them all

_ew0.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 0 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew1.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 1 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew2.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 2 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew3.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 3 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew4.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 4 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew5.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 5 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew6.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 6 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ew7.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 7 of each entry of the enemy table counted from 0xAA before its life, to find the word that says what the enemy is (Allen O'Neil, a tank, a helicopter) from a capture; the same read as _hps

_ex0.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 0 of each entry counted from 0x4E before its life (if the table starts at 0x100E1C as the RetroAchievements notes may say), same purpose

_ex1.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 1 of each entry counted from 0x4E before its life (if the table starts at 0x100E1C as the RetroAchievements notes may say), same purpose

_ex2.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 2 of each entry counted from 0x4E before its life (if the table starts at 0x100E1C as the RetroAchievements notes may say), same purpose

_ex3.note: probe (1.33 test 27): word 3 of each entry counted from 0x4E before its life (if the table starts at 0x100E1C as the RetroAchievements notes may say), same purpose

stage_state.note: what the stage does (RetroAchievements code notes, 16 bits): 0x9FD4 mission complete, 0x9B88 stage part finished, 0x9DC8 stage part starting, 0x1FDA title or character select; to confirm in game

boss_flag.note: 1 while the boss of the mission is fought (Seb's captures of 23:58 and 00:22: it went to 1 two or three seconds before Brave Guerrier's life appeared and stayed through the fight; 0 all through a game that ended before the boss, 09:29), found in the probe around the 'inside vehicle' flag; the big enemies of mission 1 have 280 to 500 of life, more than the boss, so the life alone cannot tell them apart

_p1b.note: probe (1.33 test 21): player 1's block (vehicle energy, lives, soldier, HUD state, prisoners), to confirm from a capture

_veh.note: probe (1.33 test 21): around the 'inside vehicle' flag, to find which vehicle

mission.note: mission number, 0-based in RAM (cheat database "Select Starting Mission"), to be confirmed in game, missions 1 to 6: another value is not read (Metal Slug read 183 while it booted)

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

p1_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 1 stick and buttons (P1CURRENT): 0x04 left, 0x08 right, 0x10 A. Fires the handgun and scrolls the HD backdrop, to be confirmed in game

p2_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 2 stick and buttons (P2CURRENT), same bits

hd.note: where the bosses' lives are: the whole table of enemies (_hps, a list), and the six single entries of the first captures so that they replay. While boss_flag is 1, a life of 200 or more filling an empty entry is the boss, named after the mission; mission_done ends it
